requirement.description: {reliability_ruth} proposed automating the data ingestion pipeline to guarantee timely arrival of store scan lines. The more reliable the ingestion, the fewer times the forecast job runs on incomplete data.
requirement.fact: {reliability_ruth} proposed automating the data ingestion pipeline to guarantee timely arrival of store scan lines.
requirement.reading: The more reliable the ingestion, the fewer times the forecast job runs on incomplete data.

speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: Automating scan line ingestion is a baseline, not a feature. It does not stop the forecast job from running on partial data when a store feed lags. I need a hard circuit breaker that halts the nightly job if any regional distribution centre is missing more than two percent of its expected till records.
output.correction: I am not asking for a dashboard or manual review. I want the system to treat incomplete ingestion as a failure state. This ensures we only train on complete, verified scan lines, stopping the model from learning censored demand during out of stock periods.
